facts.fact: Gong reports that opening a sales call with the reason for the call can produce a 2.1x higher success rate in booking the first meeting.
facts.quote: Gong reports that opening with the reason for the call can produce a 2.1x higher success rate in booking the first meeting

facts.fact: Practical prospecting guidance recommends spending only 60 seconds researching a prospect before dialing.
facts.quote: spending only 60 seconds researching the prospect before dialing

facts.fact: Practical prospecting guidance recommends a short sales script built around 5 to 6 discovery questions.
facts.quote: then using a short script built around 5 to 6 discovery questions and responses to common objections

facts.fact: SPIN selling stands for Situation, Problem, Implication, Need-Payoff, a staged questioning method that helps prospects reach their own conclusions.
Adwave describes its platform as AI-powered and says it turns a website URL into a broadcast-ready TV spot placed across 100+ premium channels.
facts.quote: an **AI-powered platform** that turns a website URL into a broadcast-ready spot and places it across **100+ premium channels**

facts.fact: Adwave says campaigns on its TV advertising platform start at $30 per day.
Prospeo recommends preparing responses to 6 to 8 common sales objections, according to Adwave's citation of that guidance.
facts.quote: Prospeo recommends preparing **responses to 6 to 8 common objections**

facts.fact: Adwave's sales script guidance recommends logging three outcomes after every call or walk-in: booked meeting, second conversation, and lost reason.
facts.quote: After every call or walk-in, log three things, **booked meeting**, **second conversation**, and **lost reason**.

facts.fact: Adwave's Day 1 rollout step says to write a 20-second opener in spoken language.
facts.quote: **Day 1:** write your **20-second opener** in spoken language.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide recommends listing 5 to 6 discovery questions on Day 2 of building a sales script.
The Adwave guide recommends drafting three objection branches for the most common pushbacks on Day 3 of building a sales script.
facts.quote: draft three objection branches for the most common pushbacks.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide recommends logging five real calls or messages and noting what worked on Day 5 of building a sales script.
facts.quote: log five real calls or messages and note what worked.
